  <bpmn:message id="Message_RoomServiceCall" name="Room-service call"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Evanstonian" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestCall" name="Calls room service" sourceRef="Participant_Guest" targetRef="StartEvent_GuestCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderDelivery" name="Delivers order" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Participant_Guest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_GuestCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholIncluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FetchWine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OtherOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_WaitForOtherOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Billed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GuestCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_GuestCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Room-service manager takes down the order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Room-service manager submits ticket to kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSommelier" name="Room-service manager orders alcoholic beverages from sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Room-service manager assigns order to waiter"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Begin order preparation" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Kitchen prepares food"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" name="Alcoholic beverage included?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:documentation>About 80 percent of room-service orders include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchWine" name="Sommelier fetches wine from cellar"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol" name="Sommelier prepares other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Waiter readies cart with tablecloth and silverware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Waiter prepares nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Required items are ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Waiter delivers order to guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Waiter returns to room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OtherOrder" name="Another order to prepare or deliver?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForOtherOrder" name="Wait until no other order needs attention">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_OtherOrder">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Continue to billing" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Waiter debits guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Billed" name="Guest's account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_GuestCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Task_FetchWine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">alcoholicBeverageIncluded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_FetchWine" targetRef="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PrepareOtherAlcohol" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Event_WaitForOtherOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Event_WaitForOtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_Billed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
